_doc: Echo Rally rules, read by backend/src/echo_rally/{engine,bot}.rs and frontend/src/games/echo-rally/{engine,bot}.ts. Lengths are in court units (100 units = 1 logical pixel of a 640 x 360 court), times in ticks (60 per second), speeds in units per tick, percentages as whole numbers. Side 0 is the left paddle, side 1 the right. Change both engines' tests (shared/rally_vectors.json) together.
_paddles: Each paddle is `pad_w` wide, `pad_inset` from its goal line, and moves at most `pad_speed` per tick toward its target.
_ball: Every return adds `speed_step` (up to `speed_max`); a new point starts at `speed_start`. Where the ball meets the paddle picks one of the angles below (centre = straight, edge = the last one, 60 degrees). cos/sin are x 1000.
_serve: Each point starts after `serve_delay` ticks, served toward the player who lost the last point (the first serve's side is drawn from the seed), at a random angle up to index `serve_angle`.
_powers: Chaos mode. Ids in shop order; `free` ones are owned by everyone. Timed effects last the given ticks.
_bot: Zero-Bot levels: `react` ticks before it moves for a new shot, aim `error` (+/- units at a ball speed of 1000 per tick, scaled with the speed), paddle speed in % of pad_speed, `aim_pct` = how far off-centre it hits on purpose (% of half a paddle), how many powers it brings in Chaos, `smart` = times its powers instead of firing at random moments, `center` = drifts back to the middle between shots.
